top_stories.title: Certighost Exploit Lets Low-Privileged Active Directory Users Impersonate a Domain Controller
top_stories.summary: Researchers H0j3n and Aniq Fakhrul published a working exploit called Certighost on July 24 that allows low-privileged Active Directory users to obtain a Domain Controller certificate and authenticate as that machine. The exploit leverages Domain Controller replication rights to retrieve the krbtgt secret via DCSync, enabling full domain compromise.

top_stories.title: Default Azure Automation Setting Enables Cross-Tenant Identity Takeover
top_stories.summary: Microsoft fixed a public-by-default configuration flaw and a chain of code vulnerabilities in Azure Automation that could allow attackers to perform cross-tenant identity takeover. The flaws could have enabled unauthorized access to other tenants' data, credentials, and cloud workloads through identity compromise.

top_stories.title: Flaws in Passkey Implementation Show Old Attacks Still Work
top_stories.summary: Researchers discovered exploitable flaws in Microsoft's passkey implementation that could allow attackers to impersonate privileged users. The vulnerabilities, revealed ahead of Black Hat USA, demonstrate that legacy attack techniques remain effective against modern passwordless authentication mechanisms.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra sets passkey deadline as July updates add tenant recovery
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra has set a firm deadline of September 1, 2026 for passkeys to become the default authentication method, with SMS and voice authentication retirement scheduled for February 1, 2027. The July updates also include a tenant recovery feature for Entra administrators.

top_stories.title: Okta、実行時におけるAIエージェントの保護と継続的なガバナンス自動化を実現する新機能を発表
top_stories.summary: Okta announced new features for securing AI agents at runtime and automating governance, including Agent Gateway, Agent-to-Agent Connections, and Resource Access Certifications for AI Agents. These capabilities are designed to secure AI agent access to enterprise tools and manage multi-agent workflows within Okta's identity platform.

news.title: 'Confused Deputy' Flaws Persist in Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure
news.summary: "Confused deputy" vulnerabilities have been identified in Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure, allowing attackers to acquire administrative-level permissions and bypass cloud provider access controls. This category of flaw exploits trust relationships between services to escalate privileges without proper authorization checks.

news.title: New Certighost PoC exploit lets attackers hijack Windows domains
news.summary: A proof-of-concept exploit called "Certighost" has been released targeting Windows Active Directory Certificate Services, enabling authenticated attackers to potentially compromise entire Windows domains. The vulnerability affects AD CS, a core component of Windows PKI infrastructure used for authentication and certificate-based identity management.

news.title: Why Implementing Identity Security Doesn't Have to Be Complicated
news.summary: An article argues that identity security implementation can be simplified by starting with privilege reduction. The piece offers guidance aimed at organizations looking to streamline their approach to identity security.

news.title: CTM360 Research Reveals How Insurance Phishing Has Evolved Into Real-Time Account Hijacking
news.summary: CTM360 research reveals that phishing campaigns targeting insurance and financial institutions have evolved from simple credential harvesting to real-time account hijacking techniques. The attacks now intercept authentication sessions immediately rather than storing credentials for later use, effectively bypassing MFA protections.

news.title: Seeing AI Agents Is Not Enough. Security Teams Must Enforce What They Can Do
news.summary: The article addresses the challenge of enforcing least privilege and access controls for AI agents, examining approaches including identity-layer access controls. It covers the security maturity curve for AI agents, from visibility to control, with relevance to IAM concepts like authorization and least privilege enforcement.

news.title: Russian Espionage Group Exploited Zimbra Zero-Day to Steal Mail and 2FA Codes
news.summary: A Russian state-sponsored espionage group exploited a zero-day vulnerability in Zimbra's webmail client to steal emails, browser-saved passwords, and two-factor authentication recovery codes from Western organizations. The NSA and CISA published an advisory on the campaign, which required only opening a malicious message to trigger the payload targeting 90 days of email history and full email directories.

news.title: Hackers hijack hotel Wi-Fi DNS to steal Microsoft 365 accounts
news.summary: Hackers are compromising Wi-Fi devices at hotels and conference centers by altering DNS settings to redirect users to fraudulent Microsoft 365 login pages. The attack targets Microsoft 365 credentials through DNS hijacking on public Wi-Fi infrastructure.

news.title: World Foundation raises $52 million in token sale as proof-of-human demand accelerates
news.summary: World Foundation raised $52 million to expand World ID, an iris-scan-based digital identity verification system. The funding round was led by Pantera Capital with participation from Bain Capital Crypto and other investors.

news.title: CISO's guide to privileged identity management
news.summary: A guide directed at CISOs addresses privileged identity management practices in the context of AI adoption. The piece focuses on moving beyond standing access privileges to improve control over who and what accesses systems and data.

news.title: World Foundation Raises $52.5M to Scale Sam Altman’s ‘Proof of Human’ ID
news.summary: World Foundation raised $52.5M to scale its biometric "proof of human" identity network, with Pantera Capital and Bain Capital Crypto leading the token sale. The project, associated with Sam Altman, focuses on distinguishing humans from AI agents using its iris-scanning ID system.

news.title: Hotel Wi-Fi Routers Compromised to Steal Corporate Login Credentials From Visitors
news.summary: ReliaQuest researchers identified a cyber espionage campaign using DNS poisoning attacks on hotel Wi-Fi routers to steal corporate login credentials from business travelers. The attacks target the hospitality sector specifically to intercept credentials from visiting corporate employees connecting to hotel networks.

news.title: Modernizing SAP identity management with Microsoft Entra
news.summary: Microsoft Entra has been positioned as a centralized identity control plane for SAP environments, integrating directly with SAP Cloud Identity Services and SAP Identity Access Governance. The integration enables organizations to automate identity lifecycle management across SAP applications through this combined Microsoft-SAP architecture.

news.title: MCP Security Best Practices: Authentication, Authorization, and Secure Tooling
news.summary: The article covers security best practices for Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations in .NET, focusing on authentication and authorization for AI integrations. It addresses how to protect enterprise data when connecting AI systems to tools and services, which intersects with IAM controls in agentic AI architectures.

news.title: Goodbye SMS or phone calls — Microsoft is making passkeys the default authentication process for businesses
news.summary: Microsoft is making passkeys the default authentication method for business accounts, moving away from SMS and phone call-based authentication. The company is urging enterprises to adopt passkeys, signaling a significant shift in its default MFA approach for organizational accounts.

news.title: VU#492466: Logto Identity Platform has authentication and authorization failures in core protocol handling
news.summary: The Logto Identity Platform has been assigned vulnerability notice VU#492466, identifying multiple security flaws in its core protocol handling pipeline. The vulnerabilities include authentication and authorization failures that may allow attackers to bypass account-ownership checks and skip MFA enforcement.

news.title: FedRAMP Rev5 Is Ending: What the 20x Transition Really Requires
news.summary: FedRAMP is transitioning from Rev5 to FedRAMP 20x, replacing periodic point-in-time assessments with continuous, machine-readable evidence of security control effectiveness. The article outlines what this shift requires from cloud service providers seeking or maintaining federal authorization, with implications for how security and access controls are documented and validated.

news.title: Microsoft Copilot Deployments Delayed Over Security Concerns
news.summary: CoreView research found that security leaders are delaying Microsoft Copilot deployments due to concerns about AI assistants exposing confidential data. The concern centers on data access controls and the risk of AI surfacing sensitive information to unauthorized users.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA released a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally published internal CISA credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, to a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and access control gaps relevant to secrets management and privileged access management practices.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two members of the Scattered Spider cybercrime group pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to an August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise enterprise systems.

news.title: Hackers Used Meta’s AI Support Bot to Seize Instagram Accounts
news.summary: Hackers exploited Meta's AI support assistant chatbot to reset Instagram account passwords and seize accounts, including those of the Obama White House and a U.S. Space Force official. Instructions for manipulating the AI bot to bypass normal account recovery authentication were circulated on Telegram, enabling the account takeovers.
